summary: Old QVC Group, Inc. filed an 8-K reporting effectiveness of its prepackaged Chapter 11 plan on August 6, 2026, emerging from bankruptcy. The plan had been confirmed on July 20, 2026, by the Bankruptcy Court for the Southern District of Texas. On the effective date, the company issued $1,240,362,247 aggregate principal of 10.000% First Lien Senior Secured Takeback Notes due 2032 as part of the takeback debt under the plan. The filing covers new debt instruments, termination of prior agreements, and modifications to security holder rights. What to watch: post-emergence trading of the new notes and equity and any related litigation.
